action: Facing right throughout, lift both forearms together forward to the right into a two-handed rifle aiming posture. Both elbows remain bent in front of the chest, both hands point right, front hand farther right than rear hand. Hold the aim briefly, recoil slightly, then lower both hands back to the supplied resting pose. Feet stay planted, head stays in profile. Empty hands, no weapon or effects. Never swing either arm backward.
